blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, ALBAY, Philippines — Camarines Sur Gov. Luis Raymund Villafuerte Jr. has disputed the labeling of his province as the poorest in Bicol, citing a clarification from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) that the term is not an official statistical designation. In a letter dated Oct. 15, PSA Regional Statistical Services Office V Director Cynthia L. Perdiz said CamSur recorded a 23-percent poverty incidence among families in 2025, the highest among Bicol’s six provinces.
